name: watch-video
description: Watch a video, a folder or a whole volume for the edit. /run-volume identifies the media, routes it through the local models and writes a content ledger per folder (shot sentence, light, time of day, what is on screen, KEEP/MARGINAL/CUT with the reason), no agents and no setup step. Needs Python 3.9+. A measurement always beats the reader's guess, and the summary says plainly when the reader did not run. /reflect ranks a pool against an ask.
